page.overview:
Who is Robert Kirkman?

Robert Kirkman is the creator of the Amazon Prime Video series Invincible and the co-creator of the comic book series it is based on (alongside Cory Walker and Ryan Ottley).

He also co founded Skybound Entertainment.

His favorite episode of the series is “I'm Not Going Anywhere”. In the creator's own words: "Episode 7 of Season 2 has a scene that I've been dying to adapt from the comics into the show. I can't wait for people to see the way that we changed it because it couldn't be done in the same way. I'm speaking in code now because of the way it is in the comics. We had to change it completely, and so we kind of had to like rebirth a fan-favorite iconic scene in a way that works in animation. So it's the same, but it's 100% fundamentally different. So I wanna see if it has the same effect and is as beloved."

Also known as: Kirkman.
